title: Resolve the combined chase settings layout conflict with main
public_pr_body:
Resolve the combined chase line's add/add conflict with current main in components/chase/settings-card.tsx. Merge main locally and retain both its layout and the existing chase-step test hook. No behavior or test assertions are changed to settle the conflict.

Base: codex/chase-combined (#207), so this follows the reviewed chase integration. A read-only merge-tree check confirms this head now merges cleanly with main 787ba18. No docs diff and no SQL applied.

Validation: all 5,311 unit tests across 385 files passed, typecheck passed, and ESLint passed with three existing warnings and zero errors. Live browser/database checks and production build were not run.
